title: Mother Archetypes
name: Mother
summary: Nurture and protection; the task is to sustain life without possessing it.
essence: Care that feeds growth, guards what is vulnerable, and strengthens autonomy.

items.name: Guardian
items.gifts: The buffalo-woman current: steadfast protection of people, thresholds, and values.
items.growthPath: Protect what is vulnerable while allowing trusted life to cross the threshold.
practices: Define the threat using evidence rather than alarm.
Name what would earn a gradual increase of trust.

shadows.name: Controlling Sentinel
description: Protection expands without trust. She scans for danger, restricts others' choices, and treats uncertainty as proof of threat. Those under her care remain safe only by remaining small, dependent, or inside her perimeter.
declarations: If I relax, harm will enter.
I know the danger better than you do.
Freedom is not worth the risk.
balancing: Separate likely risk from imagined catastrophe.
Share safety decisions with capable people.
Test trust through graduated freedom.
shadows.gift: Her alertness becomes wise guardianship when it protects capacity instead of replacing it.
outOfBalance: Cannot stand down after safety returns

shadows.name: Open Gate
description: Protection collapses into trust without discernment. She minimizes warning signs, avoids the discomfort of refusal, and leaves vulnerable people or values exposed. Calling everyone good substitutes sentiment for stewardship.
declarations: A boundary would be unkind.
People deserve trust regardless of pattern.
Naming danger only creates fear.
balancing: Act on repeated evidence, not promised intent.
Make one boundary explicit and enforceable.
Accept that protection may disappoint someone.
shadows.gift: Her openness becomes resilient trust when the gate can also close.

mature.title: Mature Guardian
paragraphs: The Mature Guardian keeps a living threshold, not a permanent wall. She reads risk accurately, uses the least force necessary, and relaxes protection when conditions change. Her trust is neither automatic nor cynical; it is built through character, repair, and demonstrated capacity.

declarations: I guard what is precious without imprisoning it.
Trust can be earned, tested, and repaired.
A boundary is an act of stewardship.
I stand down when protection is no longer needed.

balance.qualities: Protective, Discerning, Devout, Grounded, Steadfast, Strong, Courageous, Honorable, Patient, Trustworthy

virtues.title: Protection
paragraphs: Protection preserves vulnerable life, values, and thresholds from credible harm.

virtues.title: Trust
paragraphs: Trust permits relationship, freedom, and mutual reliance where evidence makes them warranted.

items.name: Mother
items.gifts: Nurture that protects dependence while preparing it to grow beyond her.
items.growthPath: Give what sustains life, then make room for life to develop its own strength.
practices: Ask whether the moment calls for comfort, help, or space.
Let a loved one complete an age-appropriate struggle.

shadows.name: Engulfing Mother
description: Nurture overrides autonomy. She anticipates needs, prevents difficulty, and keeps herself central to another's functioning. Protection becomes possession when growth is treated as rejection or danger.
declarations: No one will care for you as I do.
Your struggle means I have failed.
Being needed is how I know I matter.
balancing: Wait for a request before stepping in.
Celebrate competence that makes you less necessary.
Build identity and support beyond caregiving.
shadows.gift: Her vigilance becomes a secure base when it protects development rather than dependence.

shadows.name: Unavailable Mother
description: Nurture collapses while autonomy becomes premature self-sufficiency. She withholds comfort, provision, or protection and calls the resulting loneliness resilience. Need is treated as weakness because responding might expose her own limits or longing.
declarations: They need to learn the hard way.
Comfort only creates dependence.
I cannot be responsible for every feeling.
balancing: Respond to the need that actually exists.
Offer dependable care without demanding gratitude.
Repair absences instead of defending them.
shadows.gift: Her respect for independence becomes empowering care when it is built on reliable connection.

mature.title: Mature Mother
paragraphs: The Mature Mother offers a secure base and an open gate. She notices real dependency, gives proportionate care, and gradually transfers responsibility as capacity grows. Her love can survive being less needed because its purpose is the flourishing of the life entrusted to her.

declarations: I nourish growth that will not belong to me.
Care and freedom can increase together.
I can be needed without making need permanent.
I protect vulnerability and welcome emerging strength.

balance.qualities: Nurturing, Steady, Protective, Generous, Patient, Wise, Resilient, Grounded, Empowering, Trustworthy

virtues.title: Nurture
paragraphs: Nurture supplies the attention, protection, and resources on which life depends.

virtues.title: Autonomy
paragraphs: Autonomy honors the other as a distinct person capable of choice, struggle, and development.

items.name: Peacemaker
items.gifts: The peace-bringer current: reconciliation that can survive honest conflict.
items.growthPath: Seek a peace that includes the truth, not merely the end of visible tension.
practices: Name the conflict in one neutral sentence before mediating it.
Ask whose cost is hidden by the current calm.

shadows.name: Peace Enforcer
description: Reconciliation becomes intrusive without confrontation. She pressures forgiveness, edits anger, and restores surface calm before harm has been named. Her mediation protects the comfort of the room more than the people carrying the injury.
declarations: We need to move past this now.
Anger only makes things worse.
Both sides must be equally responsible.
balancing: Let the injured person set the pace of repair.
Name asymmetry and harm plainly.
Tolerate unresolved tension without forcing reunion.
shadows.gift: Her gift for common ground becomes restorative leadership when truth is allowed to disturb the peace.

shadows.name: Resentful Bystander
description: Reconciliation collapses as confrontation is avoided rather than used. She withdraws, keeps a private ledger, and lets conflict harden into moral distance. Silence appears peaceful while relationship decays from the absence of an honest encounter.
declarations: Speaking will only create more conflict.
They should know what they did.
Distance is the mature response.
balancing: Make one direct, bounded statement of impact.
Request a specific repair rather than rehearsing blame.
Allow a difficult answer to remain part of relationship.
shadows.gift: Her sensitivity to tension becomes patient timing when it eventually serves contact.

mature.title: Mature Peacemaker
paragraphs: The Mature Peacemaker knows that conflict and peace are stages of the same repair. She can slow escalation, protect the vulnerable, name what happened, and invite responsibility without predetermining reunion. The peace she serves is not compulsory closeness but restored truth, safety, and choice.

declarations: I do not purchase calm with silence.
Truth can be spoken without contempt.
Repair cannot be forced, but it can be invited.
Peace returns choice to everyone affected.

balance.qualities: Calm, Courageous, Honest, Restorative, Listening, Fair, Bridging, Patient, Rooted, Compassionate

virtues.title: Reconciliation
paragraphs: Reconciliation rebuilds workable relationship after truth and responsibility have had their place.

virtues.title: Confrontation
paragraphs: Confrontation turns toward a real conflict directly enough for change to become possible.

items.name: Warrior
items.gifts: The huntress current: focused ferocity in defense of life and purpose.
items.growthPath: Mobilize force cleanly, then stop when the work is done.
practices: Define the objective and the stopping condition before conflict.
Discharge activation through breath and movement after action.

shadows.name: Rampaging Warrior
description: Ferocity breaks restraint and begins serving its own momentum. She escalates, humiliates, or keeps fighting after the boundary is secure, turning a just cause into permission for domination. Victory matters more than the life she meant to defend.
declarations: Only overwhelming force will make them understand.
Backing down is weakness.
My cause justifies my impact.
balancing: Use force proportionate to the present threat.
Set and honor a clear stopping condition.
Repair harm that was not necessary to the aim.
shadows.gift: Her fire becomes decisive courage when it remains governed by purpose.

shadows.name: Disarmed Warrior
description: Ferocity collapses and restraint becomes inhibition. She cannot access anger, defend a boundary, or pursue a difficult aim because force itself feels dangerous. The body knows a no that the voice will not deliver.
declarations: Conflict will make me cruel.
Endurance is more virtuous than resistance.
Someone stronger should intervene.
balancing: Practice a direct no at low stakes.
Let anger identify what needs protection.
Take one concrete action before seeking consensus.
shadows.gift: Her caution becomes disciplined strength when it can mobilize on behalf of what matters.

mature.title: Mature Warrior
paragraphs: The Mature Warrior has access to force without being possessed by it. She chooses worthy aims, trains for competence, acts in proportion, and remembers the humanity of everyone involved. Her restraint is not timidity; it is what makes her ferocity precise and trustworthy.

declarations: My fire answers to purpose.
I can be fierce without becoming cruel.
I defend a boundary and stop when it holds.
Restraint concentrates my strength.

balance.qualities: Focused, Courageous, Strategic, Protective, Disciplined, Determined, Just, Skilled, Precise, Fierce

virtues.title: Ferocity
paragraphs: Ferocity mobilizes concentrated energy against a real obstacle or threat.

virtues.title: Restraint
paragraphs: Restraint governs timing, proportion, and cessation so force remains in service.

items.name: Community Weaver
items.gifts: The community-goddess current: creating durable belonging across difference.
items.growthPath: Connect people without trading truth, consent, or standards for cohesion.
practices: Make introductions with permission and a clear purpose.
Name one tension directly before trying to restore belonging.

shadows.name: Enmeshing Networker
description: Belonging outruns accountability. She brokers closeness, loyalty, and information to stay central, smoothing over harm when truth might divide the group. Connection becomes a web that is difficult to leave without social cost.
declarations: Everyone should be included on my terms.
Naming harm would fracture the circle.
I know who needs to be connected.
balancing: Ask consent before sharing stories or contacts.
Let relationships exist without your mediation.
Address harm even when cohesion becomes uncertain.
shadows.gift: Her social intelligence becomes connective stewardship when people remain free inside the network.

shadows.name: Isolated Helper
description: Belonging withdraws behind accountability turned self-sufficiency. She contributes tasks and standards but does not risk mutual need, using usefulness as a substitute for membership. Others can rely on her labor yet cannot know or support her.
declarations: I belong through what I provide.
Need would compromise my independence.
Groups always become messy.
balancing: Ask the community for one concrete form of support.
Share experience, not only expertise.
Remain present through a repairable disappointment.
shadows.gift: Her independence becomes dependable contribution when it participates in reciprocal belonging.

mature.title: Mature Community Weaver
paragraphs: The Mature Community Weaver builds connection sturdy enough for truth. She notices who is absent, links gifts to needs, and creates norms that protect both belonging and consequence. She does not make herself indispensable; a healthy web can redistribute load and survive her stepping back.

declarations: Belonging does not require secrecy or sameness.
I connect people without owning their bonds.
Accountability can restore the web.
I participate as a member, not only a helper.

balance.qualities: Collaborative, Relational, Generous, Inclusive, Reciprocal, Attentive, Harmonizing, Strategic, Resilient, Joyful

virtues.title: Belonging
paragraphs: Belonging creates mutual recognition, participation, and a felt place in the whole.

virtues.title: Accountability
paragraphs: Accountability makes relationship answerable to agreements, impact, and repair.

items.name: Hearth Keeper
items.gifts: The hearth-goddess current: warmth, continuity, and reciprocal domestic care.
items.growthPath: Make welcome without making endless availability the price of belonging.
practices: State the limits of an invitation before resentment does.
Receive one act of care without managing how it is given.

shadows.name: Martyr Host
description: Hospitality consumes privacy. She makes herself continually available, monitors everyone's comfort, and hides her needs until resentment leaks through service. The home looks welcoming but depends on one person having no protected interior life.
declarations: A good home asks nothing of its guests.
Rest can wait until everyone is content.
They should notice all I do without being told.
balancing: Name capacity before offering care.
Let household labor be visible and shared.
Protect time and space that are not communal.
shadows.gift: Her devotion becomes sustaining warmth when welcome includes the host.

shadows.name: Closed Hearth
description: Hospitality goes cold as privacy becomes exclusion. She protects order, energy, or intimacy by making others feel like intruders. The hearth remains pristine but cannot perform its purpose of sheltering real, imperfect life.
declarations: Other people disturb the peace I built.
I can connect without opening my space.
Needs are an invasion.
balancing: Offer one clear, bounded welcome.
Allow shared space to bear signs of use.
Communicate a limit without withdrawing affection.
shadows.gift: Her inwardness becomes restorative sanctuary when it can open and close deliberately.
outOfBalance: Uses the home to avoid relationship

mature.title: Mature Hearth Keeper
paragraphs: The Mature Hearth Keeper creates places where bodies settle and belonging becomes tangible. She tends rhythm, beauty, food, and rest while preserving privacy and distributing labor. Her hearth has a door: it can welcome generously, close cleanly, and reopen without guilt.

declarations: My welcome has shape and limits.
Care for the hearth includes care for its keeper.
Privacy renews my capacity for hospitality.
Belonging is made together.

balance.qualities: Devoted, Warm, Steady, Reciprocal, Boundaried, Simple, Grounded, Gracious, Attentive, Reliable

virtues.title: Hospitality
paragraphs: Hospitality makes room for another person's body, needs, and presence.

virtues.title: Privacy
paragraphs: Privacy preserves inward space, rest, and the intimate boundaries of a household.
